Manual refactor consistency suite

contributor-tools-refactor-consistency-readme.Rmd

Contributing · Object model · Discovery walkthrough · Object fields

This preserved suite compares current SCEPTRE with source-verified original 21f9ea098b69c444a884a49bc254de711968e3b5. It is outside package-test discovery, excluded from the source package and never called by CI. See the parent handoff README for the command, dependency preflight, required backed coverage and interpretation of failures/skips.

The original helpers, comparison tests and complete fixtures remain byte-for-byte preserved from finishing commit 04df2f0. relocation.json binds those 32 files to their SHA256 values. Never regenerate historical expectations from candidate code. The source-verified original produces same-environment observations in a separate process; candidate comparisons require the exact input/source/environment checks and complete random-draw banks. The recorded-toolchain stream check can skip elsewhere; the same-environment comparison remains required.

This suite does not replace the current package’s independent mathematical, workflow, probability, ownership, saved-format and warning tests. It does not qualify performance, actual Nextflow or a whole book render. Deliberate historical fixture-generation tools and their original instructions are preserved at the pre-handoff evidence tag.

Developed by Timothy Barry, Louis Deutsch, Eugene Katsevich, Wharton Analytics, National Science Foundation.
